title: Como Se Dice --- The Sentence That Unlocks the Rest
label: ch:como-se-dice
canDo: I can ask how something is said, and say which se that is.

payoff.summary: Complete ES-C52-como-se-dice: ask the question politely and say why it is impersonal rather than aimed at the listener.
payoff.note: The one sentence that lets a conversation repair itself: it gets the reader a word they do not have, from the person in front of them, mid-conversation.
